topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic introduces the lecture structure, learning outcomes, and the progression model of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated growth signaling and pathway mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic mutations in receptor tyrosine kinase and Wnt/beta-catenin pathways drive self-sufficiency in growth signals and escape from growth inhibition.

topics.label: Block to terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how differentiation arrest contributes to tumor development in both hematopoietic malignancies and intestinal epithelial carcinomas.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through alterations in p53 regulation and Bcl-2 family protein interactions.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, telomere maintenance, and senescence bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how cancer cells overcome the Hayflick limit and cellular senescence by reactivating telomerase and bypassing p53-mediated stress surveillance.

topics.label: Metabolic rewiring and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce complex hallmark capabilities and examine the mechanisms, phenotypes, and enzymatic drivers of cancer metabolic reprogramming.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes how expanding tumors switch on vascular recruitment to overcome hypoxia and sustain nutrient supply.

topics.label: Mechanisms, monitoring, and genetics of tumor metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the multi-step cascade of cancer dissemination, circulating tumor cell monitoring, metastatic inefficiency, and associated genomic alterations.

topics.label: Lecture summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This closing subtopic synthesizes the lecture themes and provides concluding framing for upcoming practical sessions.
